_about: Field guide for this file. Keys starting with _ are documentation; the code ignores them.

_fields.schedule: Name of the retention schedule, printed in the report header and the run banner.
_fields.schedule_note: Free text shown nowhere; a reminder to whoever edits this file.
_fields.agency_domain: The agency's email domain. Used by the synthetic generator; reserved for future sender rules.
_fields.default_series: Series id used when the model says RECORD but names a series not in this list. Must match a series.id below.
_fields.transitory.gs1sl_item: Schedule item number for transitory messages; shown in the report's By category table.
_fields.transitory.title: Display name for that item.
_fields.transitory.retention: Retention wording quoted from the schedule.
_fields.transitory.window_days: The agency's definition of 'administrative value is lost', in days. Transitory mail older than this is proposed for deletion; younger is RETAIN_PENDING.
_fields.series[].id: Short uppercase id. The model answers with this; the database and report group by it.
_fields.series[].gs1sl_item: Schedule item number, for citation in the report.
_fields.series[].name: Series title as the schedule gives it. The model sees it.
_fields.series[].retention: Retention wording quoted verbatim from the schedule. Not interpreted by the code.
_fields.series[].retention_years: Integer years used to compute retain_until, or null for permanent. Fiscal-year rounding is not applied.
_fields.series[].description: One or two sentences the model reads to decide whether a message belongs here. Write what belongs AND what does not; this text is what makes classification accurate.

schedule: Florida GS1-SL, General Records Schedule for State and Local Government Agencies (2017 edition)
schedule_note: Item numbers and retention wording quoted from GS1-SL 2017. Verify against your own state's current schedule before production use.

transitory.title: Transitory Messages
transitory.retention: Retain until obsolete, superseded, or administrative value is lost.

series.name: Contracts/Leases/Agreements: Non-Capital Improvement
series.retention: 5 fiscal years after completion or termination of contract/lease/agreement.
series.description: Contracts, leases, agreements, amendments, statements of work, award letters, procurement of goods and services.

series.name: Personnel Records: Non-Florida Retirement System (Local Government)
series.retention: 50 fiscal years after any manner of separation or termination of employment.
series.description: Hiring, evaluations, discipline, leave, benefits, separation, anything about a named employee's employment.

series.name: Disbursement Records: Detail
series.description: Invoices, purchase orders, requisitions, payments, p-card receipts, accounts payable.

series.name: Litigation Case Files
series.retention: 5 anniversary years after case closed or appeal process expired.
series.description: Lawsuits, claims, litigation holds, attorney correspondence about a dispute.

series.name: Information Request Records
series.description: Requests from members of the public for public records or information, and the agency's responses. Not internal follow-ups between staff.

series.name: Minutes: Official Meetings
series.description: Council, board or commission agendas, minutes, resolutions, votes, official actions.

series.name: Permits: Building
series.description: Permit applications, approvals, inspection results, code enforcement notices.

series.name: Grant Files
series.retention: 5 fiscal years after completion of grant cycle or project.
series.description: Grant applications, awards, reporting, grant-funded program administration.

series.name: Correspondence and Memoranda: Program and Policy Development
series.description: Correspondence documenting policy decisions, procedures, or substantive program activity.

series.name: Correspondence and Memoranda: Administrative
series.description: Correspondence that documents an administrative action, instruction or announced procedure with operational effect and fits no other series. Not scheduling, thanks, reminders or social notes.
